default_behavior: fail-closed; resolve workflow parent production when DY_ARTIFACT_ROOT is absent
workflow_source_boundary: dy_1024 contains only code, skills, schemas, configs, tests, and immutable workflow verification history; work-specific artifacts are forbidden
intermediate_artifact_policy: candidate cards, drafts, research, assets, renders, QC, approvals, and delivery receipts stay under DY_ARTIFACT_ROOT; move staged files into the content package after content_id allocation
arbitrary_duration_input: forbidden unless --allow-duration-override and --duration-override-reason are both present
sequence: next unused NNN (001-999) per local calendar day
title_policy: keep the original title in content.json; do not put raw title text in paths
package_rule: all works, intermediates, QC reports, approvals, and delivery receipts stay inside the package directory

directory_contract.01_research: 证据、来源快照、研究中间产物
directory_contract.04_visual: 视觉计划、设计方向、导演计划和视觉路由
directory_contract.05_assets: 资产台账、录屏回执、生成任务和媒体血缘
directory_contract.06_edit: OpenChatCut、HyperFrames、Remotion 时间线和渲染工程
directory_contract.07_quality: QC、机器检查和人工视觉审核
